players.product: High-layer-count (30+ layer) and high-order (5-6 step) HDI PCBs for AI servers, plus high-speed boards for 800G/1.6T switches and optical modules

quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Electronics results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results briefing: chairman Deng Chunhua said H1 blended gross margin was 34.31%, up 3.92 percentage points year on year, with the high-end product revenue share rising steadily. Board secretary Lin Jiang said: the Dongguan AI computing HDI base (5-step-and-above HDI including mSAP) will have annual capacity of 16.72 ten-thousand square metres at full output and entered civil foundation work at the end of May 2026; the Ji'an high-layer computing board project (planned 70 ten-thousand square metres a year, mainly boards averaging 16 layers) achieved full-flow trial production of its first stage in June 2026, and its second stage was started early, aiming for trial production before end-2026; Thailand plant phase 1 (high-compute high-end boards) is in equipment installation and debugging, aiming for trial production in Q3 2026. The chairman gave planned total investments of about RMB 20.32 hundred million (Dongguan HDI base), about RMB 19.37 hundred million (Ji'an) and US$1.7 hundred million (Thailand phase 1).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 gross margin 34.31% (+3.92 points); Dongguan HDI base 16.72 ten-thousand square metres a year, about RMB 20.32 hundred million
